description: This file implements the SetVideoGeometry class, which is responsible for setting the video geometry in a media player context. It includes methods for construction, destruction, and execution of the geometry setting operation, interacting with a media pipeline and a private player interface.

classes.name: SetVideoGeometry
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the task of setting the video geometry in the media pipeline.

methods.name: SetVideoGeometry
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the task with the given context, player, and rectangle.

methods.name: ~SetVideoGeometry
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the task.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the action of setting the pending geometry and updating the player if the pipeline exists.
